# ColorPaletteManager

**Class:** `UltraCanvasColorPaletteManager` · **Group:** [Pickers, dialogs and feedback](../Groups/Pickers-dialogs-and-feedback.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasColorPaletteManager.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasColorPaletteManager.h) · `#include "UltraCanvasColorPaletteManager.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasContainer`](UltraCanvasContainer.md) → [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

Palette rows under a colour picker - add schemes from the Palette manager (a draggable popup; up to 256-colour GIF palettes), make palettes of your own, remove rows, set an entry with a right click, flood the picker with a hovered swatch

The component documentation with explained, compiled C++ examples:

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasColorPaletteManager> CreateColorPaletteManager( const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w);
UCElementDescriptor MakeColorPaletteManagerDescriptor();
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasColorPaletteManager(const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h);
UltraCanvasColorPaletteManager(const std::string& identifier, float w, float h);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `onColorSelected` | `std::function<void(const Color&)> onColorSelected` | a swatch was clicked |
| `onPalettesChanged` | `std::function<void()> onPalettesChanged` | added, removed, an entry set |
| `onUserPalettesChanged` | `std::function<void()> onUserPalettesChanged` | one made or deleted |
| `onColorHovered` | `std::function<void(const Color&)> onColorHovered` | The pointer came onto a swatch of a row (its colour), and later left the rows: for a host flooding its picker with the colour meanwhile. |
| `onColorHoverEnded` | `std::function<void()> onColorHoverEnded` | _Color hover ended_ |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasContainer`](UltraCanvasContainer.md): `SetScrollChangedCallback`, `SetChildAddedCallback`, `SetChildRemovedCallback`
- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`

## Options and setters

Everything that configures the element: appearance, behaviour and content.

| Member | Signature | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `SetPalettes` | `void SetPalettes(const std::vector<NamedColorPalette>& palettes)` | Never empty: setting no palettes, or taking the last one away, leaves the default one (DefaultPalette()). |
| `AddPalette` | `void AddPalette(const NamedColorPalette& palette)` | Adds a row at the end; fires onPalettesChanged. |
| `RemovePalette` | `void RemovePalette(int index)` | Takes row `index` away (not the last remaining one); fires onPalettesChanged. |
| `SetEntryColor` | `void SetEntryColor(int palette, int entry, const Color& c, bool notify = true)` | Sets one entry; `notify` fires onPalettesChanged. |
| `SetUserPalettes` | `void SetUserPalettes(const std::vector<NamedColorPalette>& palettes)` | Made with the palette creator ("Add palette"), offered in the palette manager under "My palettes" and kept by the host as the rows are. No callback from SetUserPalettes. |
| `AddUserPalette` | `std::string AddUserPalette(const NamedColorPalette& palette)` | Keeps `palette` among the user's own under a name nothing else has (UniquePaletteName) and adds it as a row; the name it was kept under. Fires onUserPalettesChanged and onPalettesChanged. |
| `RemoveUserPalette` | `void RemoveUserPalette(const std::string& name)` | Forgets one of the user's own; a row of it stays. Fires onUserPalettesChanged. |
| `ClearSelection` | `void ClearSelection()` |  |
| `SetManagerStyle` | `void SetManagerStyle(const ColorPaletteManagerStyle& s)` |  |
